notes.title: The first Devlog! Video-style!
notes.content: [p][/p][previewyoutube="ClojSdny_iY;full"][/previewyoutube][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590076/7cab6993be6477ca9da659a17d2a9ba4ba909b57.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590076/d09a2d36db0e4a217d7fb75132d4613c23b95a77.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590076/2a2a2bc307721a4df68f6c8ce69cef2f89126f87.png"][/img] Well hello there.[/p][p][/p][p]This is the first in a series of planned dev blog videos, and it goes over the (very) early history of the project and how it grew from a sloppy experiment into a more fully-grown 90s style RPG.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590076/473719fb47e563b498a39ba7b299a26516befe88.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]You'll see some [b]exclusive[/b] behind-the-scenes type stuff here from early builds and a few sneak peaks of the final product. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590076/19ab3701b75d13a3dac7d9894af05398597c7914.png"][/img][/p][p]Let me know what you'd like to hear about in the next one! [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45590076/48243d99f292a9d3f4f5fec5018fa24d0b2002b7.png"][/img][/p]
